info.title: IIT Academic Portal Authentication Contract
info.description: Proposed browser-facing contract for email/password authentication, role context, logout, and password recovery. Match existing API versioning and error conventions before implementation.

get.summary: Obtain a request token for browser state-changing requests

200.description: A request token is returned; the matching anti-forgery cookie is set by the service.

Set-Cookie.description: Protected anti-forgery cookie; never use this cookie as an authentication credential.

post.summary: Authenticate by email and password and create a browser session

201.description: Session created. A protected session cookie is set. The session starts in the account's default role (stored default while assigned, otherwise the first assigned role in the order Admin, Coordinator, Teacher, Student); activeRole is null only when no supported role is assigned.

Set-Cookie.description: Protected session cookie with a sliding three-hour expiry, refreshed on authenticated requests. The server rejects and revokes the session after three hours without authenticated activity; there is no separate maximum-age timeout.

401.description: Invalid credentials; response does not distinguish an unknown email from an incorrect password.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's current role context

200.description: Current account roles and this session's active role. Authenticated activity refreshes the three-hour inactivity window. A role no longer assigned to the account is omitted, and a removed active role is returned as null.

Set-Cookie.description: The session cookie is re-issued with a fresh three-hour lifetime. The session expires after three hours without authenticated activity.

delete.summary: Sign out and revoke only the current session

204.description: Current session revoked and session cookie cleared.

put.summary: Switch to another role assigned to the current account

200.description: Active role updated for this session only.

403.description: Requested role is not currently assigned to the account.

202.description: Same public response for recognized and unrecognized email addresses.

post.summary: Set a replacement password using a valid recovery proof

204.description: Password reset completed. Revoke only the session used for this reset; leave other sessions active.

Set-Cookie.description: Clears the session cookie when the request carried a session (that session is revoked).

sessionCookie.name: __Host-iit-session
sessionCookie.description: Protected browser session credential. HttpOnly, Secure, host-only, and sliding three-hour inactivity expiration; validated against per-session server state. No separate maximum age is applied.

antiForgery.name: X-CSRF-Token
antiForgery.description: Request token paired with the anti-forgery cookie. Required for browser-originated state-changing requests.

requestToken.description: Value to send in the X-CSRF-Token header.

message.const: If an eligible account exists, recovery instructions will be sent to its registered email address.

ProblemDetails.description: User-safe problem response. Must not expose stack traces, account-existence distinctions, credentials, or internal details.

Problem.description: Validation, authentication, authorization, or throttling error in a consistent problem format. Every state-changing operation returns 400 when the anti-forgery request token is missing or invalid.
